lite.room-opens-on-website.ha: Ɗakin kamfen yana buɗewa a shafin yanar gizo. Ka shiga a can domin ka gudanar da shi.
lite.room-opens-on-website.ig: Ọnụ ụlọ mkpọsa na-emepe na weebụsaịtị. Banye ebe ahụ ka ị jikwaa ya.
lite.room-opens-on-website.yo: Yàrá ìpolongo ń ṣí lórí ojú-òpó wẹ́ẹ̀bù. Wọlé níbẹ̀ láti ṣàkóso rẹ̀.
